description: This file serves as a non-cryptographic message digest wrapper that provides hash functions (DJB and DEK hashes) primarily for string hashing purposes. It includes macro definitions, inline functions, and references the 'first.h' header.

methods.name: uint32_t djbhash(const char * str,const uint32_t len,uint32_t hash)
methods.description: Computes a DJB2a hash for a given string and length, optionally using an initial hash value.

methods.name: uint32_t dekhash(const char * str,const uint32_t len,uint32_t hash)
methods.description: Computes a hash based on Donald Knuth's algorithm for a given string and length, with support for incremental hashing via an initial hash value.

ctags.name: dekhash
ctags.pattern: /^static inline uint32_t dekhash (const char *str, const uint32_t len, uint32_t hash)$/

ctags.name: djbhash
ctags.pattern: /^static inline uint32_t djbhash(const char *str, const uint32_t len, uint32_t hash)$/
